scope: Missing Ki Blast Ultimate catalog entries

records.name: Blaster Stream
records.character_source: Kale (Super Saiyan 2); Kefla (Super Saiyan) Customize Partner
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 148: Finding Out About Fusion
records.effect: Chargeable long-range beam followed by a second Ki Wave on hit.
records.evidence_boundary: Current Xenoverse 2 references reconfirm Blaster Stream as a 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate obtained from PQ148, used by Kale (Super Saiyan 2) and Kefla (Super Saiyan) Customize Partner; charge level increases damage/hits and a successful first beam produces a follow-up Ki Wave. No Ultimate Finish requirement or drop probability is established.

records.name: Brave Heat
records.effect: Ki-laced punch followed by a beam fired from the same hand.
records.evidence_boundary: Current Xenoverse 2 references reconfirm Brave Heat as Bardock's 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate obtained through Bardock mentor training. Bardock's mentor page lists it as lesson reward and his character page lists it in Battle Suit 2 and Customize Partner data. No Ultimate Finish requirement or drop probability is established.

records.name: Chain Destructo-Disc Barrage
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 46: 16 of the Official History
records.evidence_boundary: Current Xenoverse 2 references reconfirm Chain Destructo-Disc Barrage as Krillin's 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate obtained from PQ46; it fires five Destructo-Discs and is documented as unblockable. No Ultimate Finish requirement or drop probability is established.

records.name: Circle Flash
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 154: Dabura The Loyal? Servant
records.effect: Ring-shaped Ki Blast that captures the opponent before exploding.
records.evidence_boundary: Current Xenoverse 2 references reconfirm Circle Flash as Dyspo's 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate obtained from PQ154. DLC documentation places Circle Flash in Conton City Vote Pack content, while Dyspo's current character data lists it in his preset. The move captures the opponent in a ring before an explosion. No Ultimate Finish requirement or drop probability is established.

notes: All four names were absent from docs/data/skills.json at research time. Dedicated pages establish Ki Blast Ultimate taxonomy and 300 Ki cost. The documented PQ/training unlocks support player/CaC usability for the first three; Circle Flash is treated as player-obtainable through its PQ unlock and is not marked unavailable on its dedicated page. 2026-09-24 provenance refresh: current Xenoverse 2 skill references independently reconfirm all four records as Ki Blast Ultimates with 300 Ki cost. Blaster Stream remains PQ148, Brave Heat remains Bardock mentor training, Chain Destructo-Disc Barrage remains PQ46, and Circle Flash remains PQ154. Current character/DLC references corroborate Kale/Kefla, Bardock, Krillin, and Dyspo associations; DLC 13 documentation independently includes Circle Flash. Mechanics evidence confirms Blaster Stream is chargeable with a follow-up beam, Brave Heat is a punch-plus-beam sequence, Chain Destructo-Disc Barrage is five unblockable discs, and Circle Flash captures the target in a ring before exploding. No Ultimate Finish requirement or drop probability is inferred.
